summary.text:
This resolution supports the designation of National Wildlife Refuge Week.
The resolution acknowledges the importance of national wildlife refuges for their recreational opportunities and contribution to local economies.
Finally, the resolution reaffirms the support of the House of Representatives for wildlife conservation and the National Wildlife Refuge System.

title: Supporting the designation of the week beginning on October 12, 2025, as "National Wildlife Refuge Week".
